answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, weighted by independent path length. Reaching the horizon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The atlas lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the glacier is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
